notes.title: The level editor is now available!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that the level editor is now available!

You can now:
[list]
[*] Create your own levels using the custom levels tab
[*] Publish your level in the steam workshop
[*] Play custom levels created by other by subscribing on the steam workshop
[/list]

If you need help creating and publishing your custom level, I have published a guide about it that you can found here : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2787215467

I hope you will like this update, and see you soon for the next one!

notes.title: Broll 1.3 update!
notes.content:
Welcome everyone, new update, for the new year!

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
Efforts have been put to make first optimization on the game, you should have win some FPS with this update!

[h1]Expert mode[/h1]
You asked for 2 features to enchance the expert mode, and they are now available :
[list]
[*] You can now reset the expert level (and timer) using backspace or select on gamepad.
[*] The timer now starts only when your character move.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

We fixed the bugs found on the indistrial level on this steam discussion : https://steamcommunity.com/app/1265300/discussions/0/3200369112088500076/

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone 👋

For this update we have a few things to show you!

[h2]FULL GAMEPAD SUPPORT[/h2]

We fixed all the issues found with gamepad, wich means that the game is now fully playable with a gamepad! (we are also working on the nintendo switch version 😉)

[h2]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

We made modifications to make the game look a bit better : 

[list]
[*] Adding new particle effect on footsteps
[*] Changing camera settings to make the game look a bit more "cartoon"
[/list]

We also now have a working linux version of the game!

That's all for today, but we are coming soon with more!

notes.title: Broll 1.1!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we are proud to publish the biggest Broll update yet, and more are coming soon!

[h2] Local multiplayer [/h2]

You can now play Broll with a friend!

For now, only the "Royal Rumble" mode is available, but more game modes are coming soon!

You can also use steam remote play, to play with any of your friends!

[h2] Chapter 6 updated [/h2]

Chapter 6 just got twice bigger, it now includes a tiny city at the bottom of the old city in the sky.

[h2] Bug fixes and improvements [/h2]

[list]
[*] 14 new achievements have been added to steam
[*] Complete overhaul the achievements
[*] Some buttons in the main menu as been re-made
[*] The ragdoll mechanic has been fixed to work better on low-end PC
[*] The adventure end menu, only shows once now, as you asked ;)
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and tiny improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone, long time since the last update!

- We fixed bugs on low-end PC (platforms getting stuck, sticky platforms not working)
- We added a particle and sound effect for collectibles
- We improved lighting on the playground level

In the next update, we will try to improve the light and overall visuals of all levels before we start working on new cool features!

notes.title: Expert mode released!
notes.content:
[h2]You like challenges, you like speedrun? You will love Expert mode![/h2]

Expert mode is a new adventure mode for Broll, you can unlock expert chapters after completing normal chapters at 100%!

[h2]Each second matters[/h2]

You start with a 25 seconds countdown and earn 25 new seconds each time you unlock a checkpoint. If you have no time remaining, you lose!
And if you succeed by getting all the checkpoints, your time is saved, so try to do better next time!
